research_question: Does chemically diverse anchor selection improve cross-assay translation on scaffolds absent from anchors under the same paired-label budget?
estimand: Same-molecule assay translation. Source-assay activity and molecular structure are available at inference. This is not unseen-molecule structural bioactivity prediction.
independent_unit: target; assay pairs within target and repeated seeds are dependent
eligibility: Paired measurements at least 20; at least 6 Murcko scaffolds; at least 5 evaluation molecules and 8 available training anchors. Input eligibility only, no performance selection.
split: Within each assay pair, SHA256(seed, scaffold) order assigns approximately one third of scaffolds to evaluation; remaining scaffolds supply anchors. Evaluation scaffold identities remain identical across methods and budgets. Seeds 0 through 4 are sensitivity analyses, not independent experiments.
anchor_selection: greedy maxmin Morgan Tanimoto distance starting with smallest compound identifier
methods: median offset plus Tanimoto kernel ridge of residuals alpha=1
primary_outcome: MAE difference versus identity and versus offset under the same anchor selection and label budget; target-weighted descriptive aggregation only
publication_gate: At least 10 independent eligible targets, endpoint/source provenance resolved, and a separate frozen confirmatory cohort. Otherwise report only feasibility and exploratory outcomes, not a paper-ready result.
stop_conditions: Fewer than 10 eligible independent targets: no confirmatory opening
Unresolved endpoint labels: no endpoint-specific interpretation
Near-duplicate original experiments cannot be regarded as independent assays
claims_allowed: provisional feasibility observations only; no biological mechanism or guaranteed journal suitability
